usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.containers.files.create("container_id", file_id="string", file=b"Example data")
print(result)

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: Name of the file to create.

fields.name: file
fields.description: The File object (not file name) to be uploaded.

fields.name: container_id
fields.description: The container this file belongs to.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the file was created.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path of the file in the container.
